channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Rochdale entrepreneur recognised at business awards for UK-wide chauffeur directory
item.description: John Byrne, founder of Junction 21 Chauffeurs, was a finalist at the Rochdale Business Awards for his innovative chauffeur directory.

item.title: Lodge Street, roadworks in Middleton from 26 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Lodge Street in Middleton; expected timings: The restriction began at 1am on Thursday, 26 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (17 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Lower Lane, roadworks in Rochdale on 27 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Lower Lane in Rochdale; expected timings: 8am–6pm on Friday, 27 November 2026.

item.title: Cardinal Langley RC High School wins award for commitment to sport
item.description: Cardinal Langley RC High School in Middleton has been awarded for its dedication to sports and inclusivity in education.

item.title: Alan Thomson extradited from Dubai to face organised crime charges in Glasgow and Rochdale
item.description: Alan Thomson, 46, has been extradited from Dubai to Scotland to face charges related to a cross-border drug operation involving Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale primary schools launch engineering programme for pupils
item.description: Ten primary schools in Rochdale have begun a new engineering initiative to inspire students through hands-on learning and professional interaction.

item.title: Marios Plus Pizzeria rated 1 out of 5 for food hygiene
item.description: Marios Plus Pizzeria, a takeaway or sandwich shop at 8 Wood Street, Middleton, Manchester, M24 5TF, has been given a food hygiene rating of 1 out of 5, meaning major improvement is necessary, after an inspection on 20 October 2026.

item.title: NHS asks Rochdale families to help get patients home safely from hospital this winter
item.description: Families and friends are being asked to be ready to collect loved ones, prepare their homes and speak to ward teams early as North West NHS services work to get patients home sooner.

item.title: Urgent appeal for missing 16-year-old Michael from Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police (GMP) have issued an urgent appeal for information regarding a missing 16-year-old boy named Michael from Rochdale. He was last seen on Dale Road in Middleton at around 3pm on Thursday, 26 November 2026. Police are becoming increasingly concerned for Michael's welfare and are keen to ensure he is safe. He is described as 5ft 3in…

item.title: Temporary no waiting restrictions in Middleton for pantomime
item.description: Middleton will see temporary no waiting restrictions from 30 November to 4 December 2026 along Lance Corporal Joel Halliwell VC Way due to the pantomime.

item.title: Rochdale Infirmary dementia care scheme cuts hospital stays by up to eight days
item.description: Specialist dementia wards including Rochdale Infirmary’s Oasis Unit are helping patients return home sooner, with average stays reduced by up to eight days.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 27 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: First Bus Rochdale wins national Gold for Routes to Work scheme
item.description: First Bus Rochdale’s employability programme has won Gold at the UK Bus Awards after helping local young people build skills and move into work.

item.title: Greater Manchester introduces AI-assisted traffic lights and new train services
item.description: The Bee Network in Greater Manchester is set to enhance transport with AI traffic lights and additional train services by the end of December.

item.title: Six arrests made in Middleton over £6 million cannabis importation scheme
item.description: Authorities arrested six individuals in Middleton as part of a sophisticated cannabis importation plan valued at nearly £6 million, involving a shipment from Canada.

item.title: Rochdale man fined £508 for illegal waste dumping in Rossendale
item.description: Ardan Hartley has been fined after dumping builders' rubble and bathroom furniture in a skip without a permit.

item.title: Coronation Street stars to headline Rochdale pantomimes this December
item.description: Helen Flanagan and Steven Arnold will star in Aladdin at Heywood Civic, while Alex Bain will perform in Cinderella at Middleton Arena.

item.title: Haider Ali jailed for 10 years and six months for managing drug supply in Rochdale
item.description: Haider Ali has been sentenced to 10 years and six months for his role in an organised crime group supplying class A drugs in Rochdale.

item.title: Six arrested after £5.9m cannabis shipment tracked to Middleton address
item.description: Six people have been arrested after police tracked a container to Heywood Old Road in Middleton during an international investigation into 590kg of cannabis.

item.title: Rochdale Council staff take over 30,000 sick days due to stress and depression
item.description: Rochdale Council staff have taken more than 30,000 sick days due to stress and depression, costing over £4.2 million in sick pay.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to host Barnet in League Two clash this Saturday
item.description: Rochdale AFC will face Barnet at the Crown Oil Arena in a Sky Bet League Two match this Saturday, 28 November.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 26 November 2026
item.description: 1 new story in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Police stop over 100 vehicles in Rochdale and Middleton crackdown on illegal driving
item.description: Greater Manchester Police, alongside Trading Standards and DVSA, stopped 118 vehicles in a recent operation targeting illegal drivers in Rochdale and Middleton.

item.title: Campaigners oppose demolition of College Bank flats in Rochdale
item.description: Community leaders are urged to intervene as Rochdale Boroughwide Housing plans to demolish the College Bank flats, citing high refurbishment costs.

item.title: Littleborough Cricket Club crowned Cricket Club of the Year
item.description: Littleborough Cricket Club has been recognised for its commitment to the community with the Cricket Club of the Year award, celebrating its achievements and local support.

item.title: Rochdale mother sentenced for child cruelty after baby’s death
item.description: Joanna Lea, 36, from Rochdale, has been sentenced to two years in prison for child cruelty towards her son, Allister Von Lea, who died in 2022.

item.title: Rochdale nuclear veteran welcomes investigation into atomic programme's health impacts
item.description: John Morris, a Rochdale nuclear test veteran, expresses hope as an independent investigation into health impacts of Britain's nuclear programme is announced.

item.title: RFL CEO ian Nolan visits Rochdale Hornets at crown oil arena
item.description: During the visit, Nolan engaged with the Hornets' management and expressed his innovative approach to the future of rugby league. Chairman Andy Mazey described the visit as an honour and a pleasure, highlighting the positive discussions about the club's direction under Nolan's leadership.

item.title: New-look Championship structure confirmed for 2027 season
item.description: Under the new structure, clubs will play 18 league fixtures within their respective conferences, consisting of nine home and nine away games. The top five teams from each conference will qualify for the Championship play-offs, culminating in a Grand Final scheduled for 3 October 2027.

item.title: Rochdale Hornets confirm opponents for 2027 1895 Cup group phase
item.description: The Rochdale Hornets will face six teams in the opening phase of the 2027 1895 Cup, including Dewsbury Rams and Newcastle Thunder.

item.title: Heywood pub receives emergency bleed control kit from local scaffolders
item.description: The Kings pub in Heywood has received a vital emergency bleed control kit from local scaffolders to enhance community safety.

item.title: Castleton headteacher Lindsay Torrance wins lifetime achievement award
item.description: Lindsay Torrance, retired headteacher of Castleton Primary, received a lifetime achievement award at the Raising Rochdale Education Awards after 43 years in education.

item.title: Rochdale Council approves Local Plan for 11,000 new homes by 2039
item.description: Rochdale Council has approved a 175-page Local Plan that outlines housing and transport developments until 2039, pending government approval.

item.title: Inquest opens into death of three-year-old Thiago Wall from Middleton
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of Thiago William Wall, who died after choking at Cosy Toes nursery in Middleton.

item.title: Historic house on Rochdale Road to be split into two homes after renovations
item.description: The historic property designed by Edgar Wood will undergo major renovations to create two four-bedroom homes following planning approval.

item.title: Rochdale covered as GMP marks 1,825 domestic abuse protection orders
item.description: Domestic Abuse Protection Orders are now used in every Greater Manchester Police district, including Rochdale. The force says 1,825 have been issued across Greater Manchester since the pilot began.

item.title: Kentmere Primary Academy named school of the year at Raising Rochdale awards
item.description: Kentmere Primary Academy has been awarded School of the Year at the Raising Rochdale education awards, recognising its exceptional contributions to local education.

item.title: Your Trust Rochdale announces Christmas opening hours for 2026
item.description: Changes to opening hours at Your Trust venues during the festive period have been announced, with normal hours resuming on 2 January 2027.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 25 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Rochdale veteran seeks answers on son’s death after 60 years
item.description: Morris, the last surviving member of his regiment, has been seeking the autopsy report for 75 years, having applied three times without success. The report was finally obtained through a Freedom of Information…

item.title: Littleborough farm owner seeks permission for wellness retreat with sauna and hot tub
item.description: Owners of Happy Hideaway in Littleborough have applied for retrospective planning permission to keep their sauna and hot tub retreat on agricultural land.

item.title: Letchworth Avenue, roadworks in Rochdale from 23 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Letchworth Avenue in Rochdale; expected timings: This restriction began at 9.30am on Monday, 23 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (14 December 2026), or until repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Middleton Road, roadworks in Heywood from 23 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Middleton Road in Heywood; expected timings: This restriction began on 10.30am on Monday, 23 November 2026. Work will continue for a maximum of 21 days (15 December 2026), or when repairs are complete if sooner..

item.title: Police advice for Rochdale fans after substance forced Co-op Live evacuation during Don Toliver show
item.description: Anyone who went to Sunday's Don Toliver concert and has since felt unwell should go to hospital, see their GP or call 101, Greater Manchester Police say.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 24 November 2026
item.description: 7 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

item.title: Redwood School achieves strong standards in Ofsted inspection
item.description: Redwood School in Rochdale has received positive feedback from Ofsted, achieving strong standards in five out of seven inspection areas, including inclusion and attendance.

item.title: Wrexham U18s secure 1-0 victory over Preston North End with late goal
item.description: Wrexham U18s clinched a 1-0 win against Preston North End thanks to a stoppage-time goal from Oliver McTweed, marking a significant moment for the academy.

item.title: Heywood's £6 million active travel scheme faces criticism from local councillor
item.description: A £6 million road and transport scheme in Heywood has drawn criticism from local councillor Mike Howard, who claims it could harm the town.

item.title: Healey Lane, roadworks in Rochdale from 7 December 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Healey Lane in Rochdale; expected timings: 12midnight on Monday, 7 December 2026–11.59pm on Wednesday, 9 December 2026.

item.title: Clover Security Services Ltd to be wound up following resolutions
item.description: Clover Security Services Ltd, based in Castleton, Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up at a meeting held on 18 November 2026.
